name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor, elbow under shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold, keeping the hips from sagging or rotating.
Breathe steadily and switch sides. Builds lateral core stability.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: A beginner just your bodyweight core exercise for the abs. Side Plank builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
